data.title: Kalshi's appeal denied by 6th US Circuit Court, could lead to Supreme Court case. States prevail in regulating sports-event contracts.
data.description: In a recent decision, the 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals denied a legal challenge by prediction market Kalshi regarding the regulation of sports-event contracts in Ohio and Tennessee. The court ruled in favor of the states, upholding their laws on the matter. This decision marks a significant outcome for Kalshi, which had contested the legality of its operations in the face of state regulations. The ruling reaffirms Ohio's and Tennessee's authority in overseeing sports-event contracts within their jurisdictions and sets a precedent for similar cases.

data.title: Timur Turlov Elected FIDE President, Becomes First Kazakh to Lead World Chess
data.description: The President of the Kazakhstan Chess Federation and successful businessman emerged victorious in a runoff vote during the FIDE General Assembly held in Samarkand. Timur Turlov secured the position and has promised to focus on driving digital transformation within the chess community. Additionally, he plans to make a substantial investment in the global development of chess. The election took place on September 26, 2026, in Samarkand, Uzbekistan.

data.title: Platinum Analytics Cayman Limited Announces Nasdaq Hearings Panel Delisting Decision
data.description: On September 21, 2026, Platinum Analytics Cayman Limited (PLTS), a software developer catering to financial institutions in Asia and emerging markets, received a notice from Nasdaq regarding its request to resume trading. data.title: Google now offers free 1080p AI video creation using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, includes scene, timing, and watermark options for all account holders.

data.title: imogene + willie and Wrangler® Launch Landmark Collaboration Rooted in American Denim Heritage
data.description: Wrangler®, a prominent American denim brand with over 75 years of history, has collaborated with imogene + willie, a company established in 2009, known for their dedication to American denim craftsmanship. This partnership aims to combine Wrangler's rich legacy in denim with imogene + willie's focus on domestic manufacturing. The collaboration will result in a landmark collection celebrating the heritage and artistry of American denim. This partnership symbolizes a coming together of two brands that share a deep admiration for the craft, and a commitment to preserving the tradition of denim manufacturing in the country.

data.title: State Grid Hosts the 2026 “China–Brazil–Chile Cloud Open Day” Event
data.description: A global event titled the 2026 "China-Brazil-Chile Cloud Open Day" by the State Grid Corporation of China was conducted on September 22 in five locations spanning across three countries. The event took place in Zigong, China; Rio de Janeiro and Campinas, Brazil; and Santiago and Valparaíso, Chile, showcasing lanterns that narrated tales of civilization and the power grid that symbolized connectivity in modern times. The main focus was on fostering cultural exchanges and mutual learning between these nations with an emphasis on building strong relations through top-notch energy initiatives.
